# U135: The same menus everywhere: Layout says what is drawn, the head stays put, the Map is found from the bar, and a phone keeps Layout, Group and saved views in one View sheet

- **Belongs to:** the Goal map module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `GOALS-MENUS`, `GOAL-MAP`, `SAVED-VIEWS`
- **Budget:** at most 14 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U135

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- Goals (`phoneBar`).
- **Check:** The outcome (`.outcome`) shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the layout switch (`.layout-switch`) is not there (else: the layouts are still a row of buttons).
- _Note:_ Where the head and the bar are, to the pixel.
- If `phone`:
  - _Note:_ The View button says the layout and the group; the sheet holds Layout, Group, Saved views and the actions.
  - **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the View button says “{says}”.
  - **Step.** Open the phone’s View sheet.
  - _Note:_ A bare scope is nothing to save yet, so Save this view… waits until something is chosen.
  - **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if the View sheet has {groups.join(', ')} and {worked out in the journey as `acts.map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean).join(', ')`}.
  - **Check:** Checkpoint “view sheet”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
  - **Step.** Press the “Board” choice in the View sheet.
  - **Check:** The address becomes “view=board”.
  - **Step.** Press the “Map” choice in the View sheet.
  - **Check:** The address becomes “view=map”.
  - **Check:** The words “Group” in the View sheet goes away.
  - _Note:_ On the Map there's no Group to choose; and now there is something to save.
  - **Check:** (`parity`) it fails if the View sheet still offers Group on the Map, or nothing to save.
  - Done in the View sheet (`doneSheet`).
  - **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the View button does not say Map.
- Otherwise:
  - _Note:_ Layout says what's drawn; Group and Views are menus beside it.
  - **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the bar does not say the layout and the group.
  - **Step.** Press the Views menu.
  - **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if Views holds {items.join(' | ')}.
  - Press the Escape key.
  - Press the goals head (`.goals-head`).
  - For each of `['Table', 'Map']`:
    - **Step.** Choose the {l} layout (the Layout menu on a computer; the View sheet on a phone).
    - **Check:** A part of the page shows.
    - **Check:** (`parity`) it fails if the head or the bar moved in {l}: {was} → {now}.
  - _Note:_ On the Map, Group and Sort say why they can't be used.
  - **Step.** Press the summary in the group menu (`.group-menu > summary`).
  - **Check:** “The Map is always the trees.” is shown in the “Group” group (else: Group on the Map does not say the Map is always the trees).
  - **Check:** (`parity`) the select in the inline sort (`.inline-sort select`) is disabled (else: Sort can still be changed on the Map).
  - Press the goals head (`.goals-head`).
  - **Check:** Checkpoint “map”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ On the Map: no search or Needs attention of its own; the bar's search lists goals and goes to one without narrowing.
- **Check:** A goal on the Goal map shows.
- **Check:** (`errors`) the part `.map-canvas input, .map-bar input[type="checkbox"]:not(.map-troubled input)` is not there and the “Only what needs attention” field is not there (else: the map still has its own search or Needs attention tick box).
- **Step.** Type “G-48” into the “Find a goal” search field.
- **Step.** Press the “G-48” option.
- **Check:** The map node found in the react flow node (`.react-flow__node[data-id="mttr-oncall"] .map-node.found`) shows.
- _Note:_ The goal takes focus once the map has moved to it (so Enter opens its story).
- **Check:** (`progress`) there are 1 of the map node found in the react flow node (`.react-flow__node[data-id="mttr-oncall"] .map-node.found`) and the address doesn’t match “[?&]q=” (else: choosing G-48 did not go to it on the map ({p.url()})).
- _Note:_ Enter with nothing chosen narrows, as on any layout. (The pointer moves off the list first: a goal under it is chosen.)
- **Step.** Type “merge” into the “Find a goal” search field.
- Press the Enter key in the “Find a goal” search field.
- **Check:** The address becomes “[?&]q=merge”.
- **Check:** (`logged`) the address matches “[?&]q=merge” (else: Enter did not narrow the map).
- Close this browser.
